tasks.description: Completes the private-terminator family after the larger Claude builder is stable.
acceptance_criteria: Both preserve `--output -` stdout-mode and `--output <path>` no-stdout file-output mode.
Both use the pure `_bcdi_to_error_result` / `_bcdi_to_envelope_result` helpers from TASK-003E.
Existing focused tests and the TASK-000B baseline stay green.

gaps.detail: PLAN_PURE_CORE_CODEMOD.md carries 16 `### TASK-NNN:` headings; only the matching one is parsed. This chunk MUST be dispatched with `target_task_id` set so the renderer auto-injects the "Implement specifically `### TASK-NNN:`" disambiguator (TASK-007).
